subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should OpenClaw support `PluginHookAgentContext.api.resetSession(reason?)` as a public after-compaction plugin contract across all unlocked embedded runtimes?
rationale: This adds a new plugin capability with session-state and upgrade semantics; code review can validate implementation mechanics but cannot establish the intended permanent API contract or whether automatic terminal-overflow resets belong in the same change.

options.title: Approve the narrow hook API
options.body: Adopt the current-session-only deferred contract after the built-in harness defect is fixed, unrelated behavior is separated or approved, and complete lifecycle proof is posted.

options.title: Keep reset host-internal
options.body: Do not expose a public hook method; instead provide an owner-specific internal policy path for Remnic-style recovery without expanding the plugin contract.

options.title: Pause for API redesign
options.body: Hold this PR while maintainers define reset result semantics, supported hook phases, locked-session behavior, and caller reconciliation as a dedicated plugin SDK proposal.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow hook API
recommendation.body: Adopt the current-session-only deferred contract after the built-in harness defect is fixed, unrelated behavior is separated or approved, and complete lifecycle proof is posted.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most strongly connects this person to harness selection and native Codex compaction ownership affected by the API choice.
